page.title: Integrations
page.subtitle: Where your data comes from and what MyWay does with it

wakatime.name: WakaTime
wakatime.description: Your primary data source: editor time, languages, projects and active hours.
wakatime.keyHint: The key is stored encrypted and used only to read your stats
wakatime.keyInvalid: The key must start with waka_ and be longer than 20 characters
wakatime.connectSubtitle: All you need is the API key from your WakaTime account. Takes half a minute.
wakatime.syncingHint: Usually 10–20 seconds. We pull the last 90 days.
wakatime.disconnectText: We will stop pulling your stats. Data already collected is kept, but the dashboard goes empty.
wakatime.disconnectCascade: Tournament participation turns off too: the leaderboard counts hours from WakaTime data.

leaderboard.name: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: The seasonal tournament. Your hours and username become visible in the public table.
leaderboard.requiresWakatime: Connect WakaTime first — the tournament counts hours from its data
leaderboard.leaveText: You will disappear from the public table. This season's stats are kept: come back before it ends and your place is restored.

aiAgent.name: AI agent
aiAgent.description: Every morning it posts a breakdown of yesterday in Messages: where you dropped, where you grew and why.

soon.gitlabDescription: The same for self-hosted and gitlab.com
soon.figmaDescription: Time in files and edit counts — for designers
soon.jiraDescription: Ties your hours to issues and sprints
soon.togglDescription: Manual tracking for what the editor cannot see
soon.notified: We will let you know when {{name}} is ready

tags.title: What are we tracking?
tags.subtitlePreset: We preselected tags for your specialty — {{specialty}}. Remove what you don't need or add your own.
tags.subtitleEdit: Only checked tags count towards your stats and the tournament.
tags.offtopicHint: Add anything here: gaming, studying, pet projects. These are tracked separately and never counted in the tournament.
tags.nothingFound: Nothing found. You can add it as your own tag.
tags.tournamentYesHint: Your username, specialty and seasonal hours become visible in the public table. You can leave at any time.
tags.tournamentNoHint: Your stats stay private. You can join later from this same section.
tags.emptyWarning: Pick at least one tag, otherwise your stats will be empty
